name: IT team · MANAGEMENT DECISION — is the app repo (codx-junior-platform) in scope for these shifts?
description:
Management decision card. Decided by: user (ProjectManager runs it at the wake and reports the outcome).

THE QUESTION
The project these shifts run on is `codx-junior-installer`: 45 files, all shell scripts and markdown (domains demo/, cloud/, codx-junior/, codx-junior-dind/, vllm/). It has **0 tests, 0 symbols, no api/, no client/, no python package, and no .gitignore** (measured 2026-11-18 with project_health, project_map, project_read_file).

The application code — `api/tests`, `wiki/pytest.ini`, `client/tests/`, the committed `.env` / ACME key finding — lives in the PARENT repo `codx-junior-platform`, which is a different project and is not in this project's readable index.

Three IT team cards were built on the assumption that we can read, test and scan that parent repo from here: `248d0a54` (expose repo root), `d1ba037a` (declare the pytest suite), `fbb93de8` + `5ee9dbfa` (secret scan / test mapping), and the onhold `25822947` (.env/ACME remediation). None of them can succeed as written.

OPTIONS
A — ACCEPT THE NARROWING (recommended). The installer project is gated by what it is: a shell syntax/lint gate over its own scripts. The parent repo's pytest suite and secret scan are handled where that repo lives, i.e. in its own project entry, not through these shifts.
   Cost: 0 dev days. Unblocks `d1ba037a` today, keeps every existing card path valid.
   Risk: the app code has no automated regression signal from these shifts.

B — OPEN A SECOND PROJECT ENTRY for `codx-junior-platform` (new project or child project pointed at the git root), so pytest and `git ls-files` secret scans are possible.
   Cost: ~10 min of human settings + re-index + re-pointing 11 cards whose paths assume the installer root. Roughly one lost shift.
   Gain: the real test suite and the real secret scan become runnable, permanently.
   Risk: path churn across the board.

C — DO NOTHING. Leave the QA gate permanently at `tests.no-suite` and rely on artifact evidence for every milestone.
   Cost: 0. Risk: no automated signal at all, and every future QA shift re-discovers the same false negative.

RECOMMENDATION: **A now, B as a separate follow-up card.** They are not exclusive — A is the 10-minute move that unblocks tomorrow, B is the one-day investment that makes the app code gated. Doing B first delays M1 for no benefit this week.

DECIDE BY: **Thu 20 Nov 12:00 Europe/Madrid.**
IF NO ANSWER: A applies by default. `d1ba037a` declares the shell gate, `248d0a54` closes as "out of scope", and the app repo stays ungated until a B card is explicitly opened.

ACCEPTANCE: one line naming A, B or C, written as a comment on this card. Then ProjectManager applies it to `d1ba037a`, `248d0a54`, `25822947`, `fbb93de8`, `5ee9dbfa` and closes this card.

## PM correction — 2026-11-19 shift #5 (turn 4): the option letters, restated authoritatively

**This card's own description is the single source of truth for the letters. Several ProjectManager reports — including my own this shift — have described them incorrectly.** Corrected before the 20 Nov wake so nobody answers the wrong letter.

Authoritative mapping, copied from this card:

- **A — ACCEPT THE NARROWING.** Installer project only. `codx-junior-platform` stays **out of scope**. The gate becomes a shell syntax/lint gate over this repo's own scripts. Cost 0 dev days. **This is the recommendation and the default if no answer arrives.**
- **B — OPEN A SECOND PROJECT ENTRY** for `codx-junior-platform` (new or child project at the git root), so pytest and `git ls-files` secret scans become runnable. Cost ~10 min of human settings + re-index + re-pointing 11 cards; ≈1 lost shift.
- **C — DO NOTHING.** The gate stays at `tests.no-suite` indefinitely; every milestone rests on artifact evidence only.

### The correction that matters
Earlier reports on this shift summarised **A as "yes, installer + platform in scope"**. That is the opposite of what A says. **A excludes the app repo; B is the option that brings it in.** Anyone reading my TL;DR and answering "A" in order to expand scope would produce the reverse outcome. Treat that summary as withdrawn.

### How to answer without ambiguity
Write the letter **and** one word of intent — `A — narrowing`, `B — second project`, `C — nothing`. One line, on this card.

### What I apply at the 20 Nov 12:00Z wake
- **A** → `d1ba037a` declares the shell gate; `248d0a54`, `25822947`, `fbb93de8`, `5ee9dbfa` close as out-of-scope; **M3 is re-sliced** to what this repo can actually show, moved to `Review` for a management re-slice; no app-repo work this week.
- **B** → the five cards stay open and are re-pointed at the new project entry; **M3 proceeds on 27 Nov as forecast**, gated by `d1ba037a`; I open the re-index card and name the path.
- **C** → all five close as won't-do; M3's Definition of Done loses its "gate not `block`" clause and the increment ships on artifact evidence alone.

**Note on the deadline (minor, no action):** this card says 12:00 **Europe/Madrid** = **11:00 UTC**. The wake is 12:00Z = 13:00 Madrid, so the default applies one hour after the published deadline. Nothing downstream consumes the answer before 16:00Z, so I am deliberately **not** moving the wake — an early wake would risk applying default A over a late human answer, which is the worse error.

**Unchanged and still true:** no card in the M1 chain is waiting on this answer. It gates the test/secret workstream and M3, not Friday's demo.

**Concrete evidence for this decision — found while auditing `demo/up.sh` flags; do not decide it blind.**

The question this card must answer is not abstract ("is the app repo in scope"), it has a specific, verifiable consequence:

**This project is not a standalone repo root.** Verified root listing of `codx-junior-installer/`: `README.md`, `FAST-DEPLOYMENT.md`, `cloud/`, `codx-junior/`, `codx-junior-dind/`, `demo/`, `vllm/`, `package.json`. **There is no `install.sh` here.**

Yet the front-door documented to users lives in a *parent* repository:
- `README.md:22-26` → `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codx-junior/codx-junior/main/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- --provider deepseek --key ...`
- `cloud/README.md:14-15` → same URL.
- `cloud/bootstrap.sh:15` → downloads `.../codx-junior/main/codx-junior-installer/cloud/bootstrap.sh` — i.e. the parent repo vendors **this** directory as a subfolder.
- `cloud/DEPLOYMENT-CONTRACT.md:66` / `:91` → `install.sh --ref v1.2.3 --non-interactive`, `install.sh --env-file … --domain …`.

**Consequences of each answer:**
- *In scope* → `install.sh` must be added to the readable index and its `--ref` / `--non-interactive` / `--env-file` / `--domain` handling verified against `cloud/DEPLOYMENT-CONTRACT.md`. Today no shift can see it, so the documented front door is unverifiable.
- *Out of scope* → then `README.md:22-26`, `cloud/README.md:14-15` and `DEPLOYMENT-CONTRACT.md:66,91` are unverifiable documentation in **this** repo and need an explicit note saying which repo owns `install.sh`. Otherwise a demo follower hits a 404 on the first command in the README, with nothing in this tree to detect it.

**Recommendation:** at minimum expose `install.sh` read-only. It is the single command the README puts in front of every new user, and it is currently outside every shift's field of view.

Raised by software_developer, 2026-11-19, while working `2639c296` (that card's scope is `demo/up.sh` only; this is not a change request there).

## PM addendum (shift #7, turn 3) — two cards are parked on your answer at 12:00Z. Your ruling must re-arm or close them; nothing else will.

You wake 20 Nov 12:00Z to decide whether `codx-junior-platform` (the parent app repo) is in scope for these shifts. **Your answer is the release valve for two stalled security/QA cards, and neither of them will wake on its own any more.** If you answer without naming them, they rot and nobody notices.

### 1. `25822947` — committed `.env` / ACME key finding (currently `onhold`, **wake cleared**)
- The installer tree is **proven clean**: 6 read-only commands, no `.env`, no `.pem`, no `acme.json`, no key block, no live token. That evidence is on the card.
- **If A (parent repo out of scope):** close `25822947` as `done` with that table as closing evidence, and say in one line that the parent repo was never examined. Do not leave it on hold — an unresolved security card with no owner and no wake is the worst of both.
- **If B (parent repo in scope):** set `25822947` back to `todo` with a wake **after** `248d0a54` has landed (16:00Z same day at the earliest → 21 Nov or later), and state that the scan is read-only first.
- Either way: **no rotation, no history rewrite** without a separate user-approved decision.

### 2. `fbb93de8` — whole-repo tracked-secret scan (wakes **20 Nov 00:00Z**)
One correction to my own earlier report: I wrote last turn that this card is "gated behind `e70e0272` (12:00Z) and `248d0a54` (16:00Z)". **That is false** — it wakes at 00:00Z, twelve hours *before* your decision. It is not gated on you at all. Its deliverable was narrowed in the same ruling to enumerating the **installer subtree**, which does not require the parent repo, so waking early is correct: it produces a real partial result instead of waiting.
- **If B:** the parent-repo half is *not* added back to `fbb93de8`. It goes to `25822947` under the re-arm above. Keep them separate so a failure in one does not mask the other.

### What your decision does NOT change
- The **M1 demo chain** (21 Nov, or 23 Nov under Option B) — no `demo/` file depends on the parent repo.
- The **QA infrastructure chain** (`d1ba037a` 24 Nov 10:00Z → `5ee9dbfa` 12:00Z → `716c63f8` 14:00Z) — already sequenced around both candidate demo days.
- `248d0a54` (16:00Z) — it is the technical prerequisite and runs either way.

### The form of the answer I need
Not a paragraph — one of two sentences, plus who authorised it:
- **"A — parent repo out of scope; shifts cover `codx-junior-installer` only."** (Then `25822947` closes; the risk is named and accepted.)
- **"B — parent repo in scope; expose it and scan it."** (Then `25822947` re-arms after `248d0a54`.)

If no answer arrives, the default is **A**, and I will write that on the card at the next shift: an unanswered scope question is not an expansion of scope.
